services.name: Karting
services.desc: Our karts deliver instant torque the moment you hit the pedal on our 265 meter indoor track, where grippy race tires bite every bend and remote speed monitoring keeps beginners safe as pros chase precision. Experience the thrill of racing with our adult electric go-karts at Kelowna Karting! Powered by a 10.5kW brushless motor and lithium batteries, these karts deliver instant speed and smooth handling. With adjustable seats, F1-style steering, heavy-duty impact protection, and advanced safety features like remote shut down and automatic slowdown for incidents, you’ll enjoy a safe, high-performance ride every time. services.desc: Experience the next level of axe throwing! Our interactive system transforms traditional axe throwing into a dynamic, high-tech experience. Perfect for beginners and seasoned throwers alike, this attraction combines exciting games, automatic scoring, and a vibrant atmosphere for unforgettable fun. Our interactive axe throwing uses real axes and real wooden target boards for a fully authentic experience. The projected games add a fun digital twist, but every throw still hits a genuine wooden target with real impact. All axe throwers must be at least 12 years old.
